utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Please call the case, Mr. Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. This is case number IT-05-88-A, The Prosecutor versus Vujadin Popovic et al. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: May I have the appearances, beginning with the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MS. MONCHY
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Virginie Monchy and Francois Boudreault for the Prosecution, together with Janet Stewart, our Case Manager.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: And for the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. For Mr. Vujadin Popovic, Zoran Zivanovic. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. John Ostojic for Mr. Ljubisa Beara.

utterances.speaker: MS. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honour. Jelena Nikolic and Stephane Bourgon with Ivan Danilovic for Mr. Drago Nikolic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. HAYNES
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Peter Haynes for Vinko Pandurevic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. MS. FAUVEAU [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honour. Natacha Fauveau Ivanovic with co-counsel, Nenad Petrusic, for Radivoje Miletic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRGOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honour. Dragan Krgovic along with David Josse for the absent General Gvero.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. Let me now provide a brief summary of the status of the case. With respect to the briefing process, the B/C/S translation of the Trial Judgement was filed on the 3rd of January. On the same day the Appeals Chamber issued an order setting a time-limit to file any amended grounds of appeal by the 3rd of May, 2012. No such motions have been received by the Chamber. With regard to motions before the Chamber, we have the following: Two motions filed by Mr. Popovic, on Rule 115, the third and fourth motions, pursuant to Rule 115, filed on the 15th August, 2011, and 19 September, 2011, all responses and replies to these two motions have been received by the Appeals Chamber and both motions remain under consideration by the Chamber. Two motions filed by Mr. Miletic pursuant to Rule 115. These are the first and second motions pursuant to Rule 115 filed on the 30th of March, 2012 and the 7th of May, 2012. The English translation of the first motion was filed on the 11th of April, 2012, and the Appeals Chamber has received the Prosecution's response and Mr. Miletic's reply to the motion. The Chamber is awaiting the English translation of Mr. Miletic's reply and is also awaiting the English translation of the second motion. May we now move into private session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: And I now ask --

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes. I now ask the Appellants whether they wish to raise any matter regarding their health or the conditions of their detention. First, Mr. Popovic. THE APPELLANT POPOVIC: [Interpretation] Your Honours, I did not have any problems at the time. Thank you for a your concern.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Now, Mr. Beara. THE APPELLANT BEARA: [Interpretation] I have no complaints or any demands.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Nikolic. THE APPELLANT NIKOLIC: [Interpretation] Mr. President, I'm of good health. I have no complaints regarding the Detention Unit.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Mr. Miletic. THE APPELLANT MILETIC: [Interpretation] Mr. President, I have no complaints.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Pandurevic. THE APPELLANT PANDUREVIC: [Interpretation] Your Honours, everything is fine. I have no complaints. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you very much. And I'm sure you're all happy to see that I didn't require any interpretation for those answers. Thank you very much. I now ask whether there are any addition matters to be raised by the Prosecution or by any counsel. Prosecution?

utterances.speaker: MS. MONCHY
utterances.text: No. Thank you. Nothing at the time, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Any Defence counsel?

utterances.speaker: MR. HAYNES
utterances.text: Your Honour, to keep matters consistent, we better drop quickly into private session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Private session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're back in open session, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: I've already asked whether there are any addition matters. My understanding is that there isn't any, so the hearing is adjourned.
